## History

In her correspondence, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounted recent events involving her pupils to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md). She described confronting [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) after discovering that the student had copied old love letters to complete a writing assignment. Additionally, she highlighted a imaginative composition submitted by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), in which he wrote about his rock friends.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P10](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0010), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P14](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0014), +14 more_
